turns.input: Niles Vanner gives Nicco a pair of leather boots.
turns.narration:
Niles Vanner reaches into his reinforced waistcoat pocket and withdraws a pair of leather boots, somewhat scuffed but serviceable. He holds them out with a slight spin of the empty balance pan on his counter—a habit when weighing decisions. "Here. Given the circumstances, I can spare these." His tone stays flat, commercially patient, without warmth or expectation.

The boots pass to Nicco's hands. Niles watches the transfer with that slightly skeptical, difficult-to-read expression, his one overly white artificial tooth catching the daylight. He offers nothing further: no instructions, no commentary on fit or quality, no acknowledgment of what prompted the gift.

The square around them maintains its moderate daytime traffic, a few passersby glancing toward Heartstone's massive wooden entrance without lingering. The Coined Lie's low façade faces the square somewhere nearby, though neither man looks toward it.

turns.input:
Thanks *he said to them, after which he decides to give them back the boots*
You'll need them more than me
turns.narration: Niles Vanner's eyebrows rise slightly, the empty balance pan stilling in his fingers. "The circumstances," he repeats, with a patient, analytical calm that nevertheless carries the weight of someone who has seen many offers refused and many more accepted for worse reasons. His gaze flicks downward to the boots he still holds, then back to Nicco. "I won't insist. They're nothing special—workaday leather, solid enough. But if you're set on returning them, that's your choice." He makes no move to take them back yet, waiting on Nicco's final word.
